gse294385.dataset_title: Spatial Multi-Omics Landscape of Colorectal Cancer Macro- and Micrometastases (Liu et al. 2026 Cancer Cell)
gse294385.patient_source: GEO carries no patient identity: patient key = sample id, so patient-held-out folds are sample-held-out (the paper reports 11 patients); sections of one patient may fall in different folds
licence: GEO public (no explicit licence; NCBI places no restrictions on use or distribution)
gse294385.evidence: converted by Agent S (scripts/second_wave/convert_geo_crc.py, second wave 2026-10-22); never read by MORPHEUS model development; not in HEST
gse294385.source: GEO GSE294385, 37 Visium sections of CRC metastases, Space Ranger outputs; no WSI, no annotations, no site labels
gse294385.note: molecular replication only (no full-resolution H&E in GEO: no morphology, H-Optimus-0 or CellViT view)

gse280318_hd.dataset_title: Characterization of immune cell populations in the tumor microenvironment of colorectal cancer using high definition spatial profiling [VisiumHD] (Oliveira et al. 2025 Nat Genet; GSE280315 / GSE280318)
gse280318_hd.patient_source: section name P<n> (GEO sample titles); P5CRC and P5NAT share patient P5
licence: GEO public (no explicit licence; NCBI places no restrictions on use or distribution)
gse280318_hd.evidence: converted by Agent S (scripts/second_wave/convert_geo_crc.py, second wave 2026-10-22); the HD sections are not in HEST and were never read by MORPHEUS model development
gse280318_hd.source: GEO GSE280315 (Visium HD sub-series of GSE280318), 5 FFPE sections, 8 um bins; served here as 56 um pseudo-spots (7 x 7 bins summed, >= 25 bins under tissue) with the native 8 um layout beside it
gse280318_hd.meta_training_overlap: the Visium v2 section P2CRC of this study is HEST TENX152, a member of the meta_training study tenx_demo_bowel; the search model has seen that section
gse280318_hd.rule: HD sections only: no Visium v2, Xenium or Flex member of GSE280318 may be used for replication, and every report on this study states the TENX152 overlap
gse280318_hd.note: full-resolution tissue_image.btf not downloaded: expression + spatial only, no patches
